summary: Add a custom-profile-only native strict JSON Schema option for Reference QA V2/V3, with pre-dispatch compatibility checks, frozen identity and no fallback.
decision_refs: The advanced model remains the reference analyst while CIRP manages bounded evidence and validates returned results
Official OpenAI Structured Outputs documentation distinguishes schema adherence from basic JSON mode
Provider capability must be user-declared because arbitrary OpenAI-compatible and local endpoints do not share one guaranteed feature set
approval_evidence: The user instructed continued implementation of the new Reference framework without deleting existing features.
known_limitations: The option is limited to custom OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions routes and does not configure the Responses API.
Only QA V2 answers and QA V3 evidence decisions use native schema mode; older task families retain JSON object mode.
Offline request-envelope validation does not prove that a configured provider supports strict structured output or improves answer quality.
